text: A pure transposition only moves letters, so the message must use exactly the copper's letters. EASTNORTHEAST and BERLINCLOCK together need three Es; the copper has two.
Deleting any one carved letter does not help, and neither does the question mark before OBKR. Changing one carved letter into an E would: 93 ways.
Every pure transposition, every route and every key, is dead at once by counting, unless the copper has a carving error.
